svg.text: MOUNTING PLATE 980 x 720 (enclosure under the deck, height 210) - scale 1:3
Rows use 660 of 687 mm plate depth; every rail keeps >= 20 % spare.
Deepest device + rail 136 mm <= 205 mm inside height.
Heat 255.4 W: natural dT 32.7 K > 20 K -> filter fan 60 m3/h, dT 12.7 K.
Ducts 40 x 60 between rows; field cables enter through glands in the front wall.
